summary: Traces India's multi-faceted freedom struggle from 19th-century reform movements, regional and tribal uprisings (Birsa Munda's Ulgulaan, Sambalpur rebellion), Swadeshi movement, rise of radical nationalism, Gandhian Satyagraha, revolutionary activism, up to 1947 Independence and Partition.
key_takeaways: Master core concepts of India’s Long Road to Independence.
Analyze primary sources, maps, and architectural/legal structures.
Apply learnings to modern civic and global challenges.
